description: This is a Java test class for integration testing the Device Registration HTTP endpoint in an Eclipse Hono project. It contains multiple test cases verifying device registration, retrieval, updating, and deregistration functionalities, and manages setup and teardown of test resources.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationHttpIT
classes.description: Java JUnit test class for integration testing the Device Registration over HTTP, including setup/teardown and multiple test cases for registering, retrieving, updating, and deregistering devices.

methods.name: setUpClient
methods.description: Initializes the static registry client before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test fixture by generating a new device ID.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes the device registered during each test after its execution.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the Vertx instance after all tests are completed.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful registration of a device.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceedsWithoutDeviceId
methods.description: Tests device registration without providing a device ID.

methods.name: testAddDeviceFailsForDuplicateDevice
methods.description: Ensures registration fails when attempting to register a device with an existing device ID.

methods.name: testAddDeviceFailsForMissingContentType
methods.description: Checks registration failure when no content type is provided.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceedsForEmptyBody
methods.description: Checks that registration succeeds with an empty body.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceedsForEmptyBodyAndContentType
methods.description: Checks registration succeeds with empty body and no content type.

methods.name: testGetDeviceContainsRegisteredInfo
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of registration info contains expected data.

methods.name: testGetDeviceFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Ensures retrieval fails with correct error when device does not exist.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Tests that updating a device replaces existing information correctly.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Ensures update fails when device does not exist.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceFailsForMissingContentType
methods.description: Checks that update fails if content type is missing.

methods.name: testDeregisterDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful deregistration of a device.

methods.name: testDeregisterDeviceFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Verifies deregistration fails for non-existing device.
